TZ.description: Tz for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

IPAM_DATABASE_HOST.description: Ipam database host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

IPAM_DATABASE_NAME.description: Ipam database name for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

IPAM_DATABASE_PASS.description: Ipam database pass resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

IPAM_DATABASE_USER.description: Ipam database user for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

IPAM_DATABASE_WEBHOST.description: Ipam database webhost for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

IPAM_TRUST_X_FORWARDED.description: Ipam trust x forwarded for app. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

PORT.description: HTTP port inside this service. Keep the default to match its Railway public port and health check.

UPSTREAM_HOST.description: Upstream host resolved automatically from the linked service. Keep this reference when using the included topology.

UPSTREAM_PORT.description: Upstream port for phpipam. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Generated access password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Repository-relative Dockerfile used to build this service. Keep the supplied path.

OWNER_AUTH.description: Require owner authentication for every application route.

MARIADB_USER.description: Mariadb user for mariadb. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

MARIADB_DATABASE.description: Mariadb database for mariadb. The supplied value follows the pinned upstream deployment; change only with its configuration guide.

MARIADB_PASSWORD.description: Generated mariadb password. Keep private and preserve with backups.

MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Generated mariadb root password. Keep private and preserve with backups.
